purpose: Protect root website and Digital Card from future additive-module regressions.
rules: Wave packages must not contain root index.html, site-main.css or card.html.
New CSS must be scoped to a unique namespace (.w4-* for Wave 4).
New modules should live in dedicated folders and must not inject global element selectors beyond safe reset declarations.
Any future homepage integration must be a separately reviewed optional snippet, never bundled as an automatic replacement.
Digital Card is visually frozen unless a change is explicitly approved.
Run local-reference QA and JavaScript syntax validation before packaging.

design_identity.main_site: preserve existing Josefin Sans portfolio layout and established section structure
design_identity.digital_card: preserve existing executive luxury navy/cyan/gold card experience
design_identity.internal_modules: may evolve while using common navy/cyan/gold executive identity
